tail: t FernhillStory v0.3.0One cold winter night to find the deed that keeps Fernhill in the family.By The Sharpee ProjectIron GatesThe cab is already grinding away down the lane, its lamps swallowed by the dark. An auction notice is nailed to the left-hand gate, ruffling in the wind: FERNHILL HOUSE AND GROUNDS, BY ORDER OF THE ESTATE, AT DAWN.The wind comes off the downs and worries at the bare limes.
